EmailDispatchDocument.title: EmailDispatchDocument
EmailDispatchDocument.description: Cloud Firestore trigger-email document that stores recipient metadata, composed subject/body content, sender attribution, and real-time Gmail delivery state.

to.description: Bounded list (1-5) of destination email addresses.

replyTo.description: Optional Reply-To email address for the composed message.

collectionName.description: Target Firestore collection where the trigger document resides.

message.description: Email content payload containing subject (1-200 chars), text (1-10000 chars), and optional html (<=20000 chars).

delivery.description: Lifecycle tracking sub-object with state (PENDING|PROCESSING|SUCCESS|ERROR), attempts (0-20), info, error, gmailMessageId, gmailThreadId, startTime, endTime.

senderUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the document creator.

senderEmail.description: Verified email address of the sender.

attachmentNames.description: Optional bounded list (<=4) of attached filenames (<=160 chars each).

updatedAt.description: Server update timestamp enforced via request.time.

/mail/{docId}.description: Primary Trigger Email collection: documents written here compose and send outbound emails via Gmail.

/contact_emails/{docId}.description: Support & Contact email queue collection triggering outbound email composition.

/email_queue/{docId}.description: General outbound email queue collection monitored for document writes.

/test/{docId}.description: Read-only boot connectivity probe document for testConnection().
